description: Nevada motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Nevada?
questions.explanation: Nevada helmet law: all riders and passengers.

provenance.manual: NRS 486.231 Protective headgear, glasses, goggles or face shields

questions.q: What does Nevada law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Nevada: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: NRS 486.351 Unlawful passing; driving abreast; prohibition on driving in extreme left lane; exceptions

questions.q: What does Nevada require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Nevada: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.

provenance.manual: NRS 486.231 Protective headgear, glasses, goggles or face shields

questions.q: In Nevada, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Nevada issues a motorcycle permit at 15½ years at the earliest.

provenance.manual: NRS 483.280 Instruction, restricted instruction and temporary drivers’ permits
